# HandleQueryAt

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Reads one property of a handle or the object behind it.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x08` SVC_MANAGEHANDLE | `MNGHNDL_QUERY (3)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
SvcResult HandleQueryAt(Handle h, QueryWhat what, size_t index);
```

**Registers:** `(h, what, index) -> r0 status, r1 value`

`what`

r1

QUERY_TYPE

handle type

QUERY_PERMS

the handle's permissions

QUERY_MARKER

the handle's marker

QUERY_STATUS

task exit status, space's last exit status, or ZUZU_OK / ERR_DEAD for a port

QUERY_SIZE

size in bytes of a memory object

QUERY_DMA_COUNT

number of DMA mappings on a device

QUERY_DMA_ID

id of the `index-th` mapping, 0 = newest

QUERY_DMA_BUS / _LEN / _DIR

bus address, length, direction of mapping `index` (an id)

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to inspect. |
| `what` | in | Property to read. |
| `index` | in | QUERY_DMA_ID: position; QUERY_DMA_BUS/_LEN/_DIR: mapping id; otherwise ignored. |

## Returns

r0 is the status; r1 the value on success.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `what` is not a known property. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | The property does not apply to this kind of object. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | DMA queries need PERM_MAP on the device handle. |
| [`ERR_NOENT`](../errors.md#err_noent) | No DMA mapping at that position or with that id. |
